The jax.dtypes module

Source: R/api_misc.R
dtypes_canonicalize_dtype.Rd

Ports of jax.dtypes: canonicalize_dtype (64-bit types map to 32-bit ones unless x64 is enabled), issubdtype (also for the extended categories dtypes_prng_key and dtypes_extended, which typed PRNG key arrays belong to), result_type, itemsize_bits, scalar_type_of (the R type of scalars of the dtype: "logical", "integer", "double" or "complex", standing for Python's bool, int, float and complex), finfo and iinfo, the dtype names float0 and bfloat16, and TypePromotionError (a condition constructor; jaxR signals it with class jax_type_promotion_error).

Usage

dtypes_canonicalize_dtype(dtype, allow_extended_dtype = FALSE)

dtypes_issubdtype(arg1, arg2)

dtypes_result_type(..., return_weak_type_flag = FALSE)

dtypes_itemsize_bits(dtype)

dtypes_scalar_type_of(x)

dtypes_finfo(dtype = "float")

dtypes_iinfo(dtype = "int")

dtypes_float0

dtypes_bfloat16

dtypes_prng_key

dtypes_extended

dtypes_TypePromotionError(message)

Arguments

dtype

A dtype name or a value.

allow_extended_dtype

Accept extended dtypes (key types).

arg1, arg2

Dtypes, values or categories.

...

Values or dtypes.

return_weak_type_flag

Also return whether the result is weakly typed.

x

A value or dtype.

message

Error message.

Value

See the descriptions above.
